entities.summary: Andris Ameriks is a Latvian politician and economist who has been serving as a Member of the European Parliament since the 2019 elections. He is a former deputy mayor of Riga. Andris Ameriks was a performers & entertainers from Jūrmala (b. 1961-03-05, Jūrmala). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
